purpose: phase8_batch_v8 with the single-claim route moved to the domain-neutral extraction prompt. Nothing else moves: the same evidence gate, aggregation policy, evaluator, tolerance table and TableCapture prompt as v8, so a difference between the two runs is attributable to the prompt wording alone.
why_routed: Values are read in batches and arm identities one at a time, unchanged from v8. What changes is WHICH single-claim prompt: targeted_v6 asks targeted_v4's question with its cohort examples written as placeholders instead of one review's disease and arm names, so a review from another field is not handed one domain as the shape of the answer.
why_v9: TableCapture stays on v1 deliberately. Its domain-neutral candidate was measured against v1 in docs/acceptance/table_capture_ab_v1.md and regressed (35 hallucinated cells against 2, cell accuracy 0.6863 against 0.9085), so the same reasoning that motivates targeted_v6 does not license promoting table_capture_v2. This profile changes the one prompt where the wording change has not yet been shown to cost anything, and leaves the one where it has.
